newsitem.title: USA: Chase Brass completes purchase of UNR unit.
newsitem.headline: Chase Brass completes purchase of UNR unit.

text.p: Chase Brass Industries Inc said on Friday it completed the acquisition of the UNR-Leavitt division of UNR Industries Inc for $95 million.
The deal is subject to post-closing adjustments that could reduce the price by about $2.5 million, the company said.
Chase Brass said Leavitt recorded sales of $156 million and EBITDA of $18.1 million in 1995. In the first six months of 1996, it recorded sales of $78.8 million and EBITDA of $7.8 million.
Leavitt will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of Chase Brass under the name Leavitt Tube Co Inc.
